profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Subaru of America
profile.summary: I have the eagerness to grow and the hunger to learn. I may not be best but i am better than I was yesterday.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered a high-throughput data ingestion pipeline processing 1M+ vehicle events within 30-minute windows, architecting for
burst traffic, horizontal scalability, backpressure handling, and failure recovery to ensure reliable downstream persistence.
Designed a secure, cross-account AWS data-sharing architecture supporting 8 vehicle data feeds using AWS KMS encryption
with S3 Bucket Keys, reducing projected annual KMS request costs by ~99% (from ~$1,800 to ~$15 per year), saving $1,785
annually.
Led procurement-grade evaluation of Postman Enterprise for the API organization, assessing OpenAPI specification governance,
RBAC, CI/CD integration, and external partner access controls to inform a build-vs-buy investment decision.
Drove a formal evaluation of JetBrains Qodana for static code analysis as Lead Developer, authoring user stories and acceptance
criteria and conducting cost-vs-value analysis across a 50+ developer, 120+ repository codebase spanning Java/Kotlin, React,
and Python to standardize code quality and CI/CD quality gates.
Engineered and deployed scalable event-driven microservices on AWS using Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB, and ECS, leveraging
AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, AWS Kiro) to accelerate implementation while maintaining code quality and
architectural consistency.
Managed and mentored a 5-person offshore development team, incorporating AI coding assistants into team workflows to raise
engineering output quality and reduce onboarding/ramp time for new contributors.
Partnered with lead engineers and vendor teams to define and implement scalable, resilient system integrations, resolving
complex integration challenges and ensuring reliable production data flow and system operation.
positions.insights: SQL Server Management Studio, Java and +15 skills

positions.insights: Spring Boot, Oracle SQL Developer and +2 skills

positions.title: Software Developement Engineer
positions.description:
Implementing solution per requirements with Object-oriented development design in C# and VB.net with reusability in mind  
Update and create stored procedures and query testing data
Enhancing and fixing the In-House configuration tool for the company using HTML, knockout.js, and T-SQL 
Developing the feature according to the system architecture and potential future change with Test-driven Development approach 
Working closely with the senior developer to achieve the team's goals and expectations with an action-oriented mindset
Participate in the design process of new features and create documentation for future use
Researching for the requirement gathering and estimation process 
Ensuring the completion of the project within the expected timeline by working with the scrum master and QA team
Manage the merging of completed work to the main test environment for continuous testing until the release

positions.title: Developer Trainee
positions.description:
Implemented a key feature of the data merging for the newly developed web application, allowing the user to merge necessary information from the database into a letter using C# with .NET framework.   
Provided development help for the front end of a web application using TypeScript using the Angular Framework
Helped team achieve its sprint goal by finishing small tasks of the product backlog items 
Provided Development support to the scrum team, while improving my skills
Unit test the Developed feature to prevent bugs related to workflow and understand the system
Got promoted for showing initiative to better the system and learn the company-specific concept implemented in the system

projects.title: Software engineering Toolkit (web app)
projects.description:
As a computer science ( software engineering ) students, we all have gone through the time, when we all had to spend more time learning about the tools for develop and maintain software than developing the software. We all know that specially for beginners this not an easy task to find right resources to learn about these tools.
Our site provides a platform for experienced faculty members to come make these tools and their learning resources available for their future and current students. Also provide other information about free services and tools offered by universities to its students. Sites also enable universities to share their tools with each other as well.
Implemented a web application with above features in team of 6 following the scrum SDLC. 
Front end: html, css, bootstrap 
Middle end: php
Back end: MySQL, phpMyAdmin

projects.title: Car popularity analysis
projects.description: Calculated the necessary statistical values from the given data set with the use of R to derived which Car is more popular with buyers and how long it last on average before buyer replace it.
